anomalies.expected: A single ATtiny-driven fan controller should have only one microcontroller populated. If two are present, they must not share all I/O and programming pins, as this causes bus contention and prevents independent operation.
anomalies.impact: If both microcontrollers are populated, they will both attempt to drive the same I/O lines (PWM, SDA, SCK, etc.) and share the same ISP programming interface, leading to bus contention, unpredictable behavior, and potential damage. The board will not function as a single ATtiny fan controller.
